places.menu_en: Myeongran-dubu-tang (pollock roe tofu stew) ₩22,000 · Cheongeo-al-jeot with tofu (salted herring roe and tofu) ₩18,000 · Cheongeo-al bibimbap (herring roe rice bowl) ₩12,000 · Samgyeopsal gochujang-gui (grilled pork belly in chili paste) ₩18,000
places.summary_en: Seafood pub in a Seochon alley, right by Gyeongbokgung Stn. Exit 2. Serves herring roe, raw fish, jeon and stews from the afternoon; known for long waits.
places.tip_en: One review mentions 50+ groups waiting on weekend afternoons, so go right at opening or join the waitlist early.

places.menu_en: Yukhoe bibimbap (beef tartare rice bowl) ₩11,000 · Yukhoe bibimbap, special ₩16,000 · Yukhoe (beef tartare, 200g) ₩23,000 · Yukhoe nakji tangtangi (beef tartare with chopped raw octopus) ₩38,000
places.hours_en: Daily 10:00–21:30 · last order 21:00 · break 15:00–16:00 or 16:00–17:00 depending on source, none on weekends per some (check before going)
places.off_en: Seems open every day (check before going)
places.summary_en: Beef tartare shop in Gwangjang Market, started as a restaurant in 1965 and now in its third generation. Michelin Bib Gourmand listed; yukhoe and yukhoe bibimbap are the signatures.
places.tip_en: The main shop and annex have separate lines, and a review says the annex wait is shorter; signing up in advance on Tabling helps, but it may need a Korean phone number.

places.name_en: Sunhui-ne Bindaetteok, Gwangjang Market Main Branch (mung bean pancakes)
places.menu_en: Nokdu bindaetteok (mung bean pancake) ₩6,000 · Gogi wanja (meatballs) ₩4,000 · Modeum (assorted: 2 pancakes + 1 meatball) ₩16,000 · Yukhoe (beef tartare) ₩21,000
places.summary_en: Bindaetteok shop that began as a Gwangjang Market stall in 1994. Signatures are crispy pancakes from stone-ground mung beans, and meatballs.
places.tip_en: Reviews say it is quiet around 3 pm and waits get long after 5 pm, so a late lunch is better. Takeout is available.
places.address_ko: 서울 종로구 종로32길 5 (종로5가, 광장시장 북2문 인근)

places.menu_en: Yukhoe (beef tartare) ₩23,000 · Yukhoe bibimbap (beef tartare rice bowl) ₩11,000 · Yukjeon (pan-fried beef slices) ₩30,000 · Yukhoe nakji tangtangi (beef tartare with chopped raw octopus) ₩38,000
places.hours_en: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sat 09:30–22:30 · Sun 09:30–21:50 (check before going)
places.summary_en: Beef tartare shop at the start of Gwangjang Market's yukhoe alley, serving yukhoe, yukhoe bibimbap and octopus tangtangi. Many tables; groups are welcome.
places.tip_en: There is no private parking, so use a public lot near Gwangjang Market or take transit (about a 3-minute walk from Jongno 5-ga Stn.). Takeout is available.

places.menu_en: Sujebi (hand-torn dough soup) ₩10,000 · Gamja-jeon (potato pancake) ₩12,000 · Chapssal saeal-ongsimi (glutinous rice dumpling soup, 1 serving) ₩14,000 · Pajeon (scallion pancake) ₩17,000
places.summary_en: Sujebi shop in the same Samcheong-dong spot since 1982. Known for thin sujebi in anchovy broth and potato pancake; Michelin Bib Gourmand listed.
places.tip_en: The Michelin Guide advises avoiding the busiest time, 12:00–14:00. It has its own parking lot, and a review says valet is ₩2,000 (check before going).

places.menu_en: Gochu-ganjjajang (spicy chili black bean noodles) ₩12,000 · Gochu-jjamppong (spicy chili seafood noodle soup) ₩12,000 · Jjajangmyeon (black bean noodles) ₩9,000 · Tangsuyuk (sweet and sour pork) price not listed (check before going)
places.summary_en: Chinese-Korean restaurant in a Seochon alley, over 50 years old. Known for gochu-ganjjajang and gochu-jjamppong, spiced with Cheongyang chili peppers.
places.tip_en: No parking, so walk from Gyeongbokgung Stn. Weekend lunch may have a wait. You can ask to adjust the spiciness.

places.menu_en: Hoe-naengmyeon (Hamheung-style spicy cold noodles, handmade) ₩13,000 · Mul-naengmyeon (Hamheung-style cold broth noodles, handmade) ₩12,000 · Tong galbitang (whole short rib soup) ₩16,000 · Hanu yukhoe bibimbap (Korean beef tartare rice bowl) ₩14,000
places.summary_en: Hamheung-style naengmyeon shop in a Namdaemun Market alley. Its sweet-spicy hoe-naengmyeon is the signature dish; galbitang and yukhoe bibimbap are also served.
places.tip_en: Reviews say the cold noodles can sell out late at lunch, so go right at opening or early in the lunch hour.

places.name_en: Makne Hoejip, Main Branch (raw fish restaurant)
places.menu_en: Hoe jeongsik (raw fish set, weekday lunch) ₩15,000 · Hoedeopbap + maeuntang (raw fish rice bowl + spicy fish stew) ₩11,000 · Gwangeo (flounder), medium ₩45,000 · Gwangeo & Useok (flounder & rockfish), for 3 people ₩70,000
places.summary_en: Second-floor raw fish restaurant inside Namdaemun Market. Thick flounder sashimi and side dishes like braised potatoes are popular, and the weekday lunch set is known as good value.
places.tip_en: The hoe jeongsik isn't on the menu, so ask for it; it's weekday lunch only, and a June review says it needs 2 people, so solo diners may prefer the hoedeopbap. No parking, so take the subway.

places.name_en: Chanio Odeng, Daehangno Main Branch (fish cake bar)
places.menu_en: Kkobului odeng (twisted fish cake), 1 person ₩10,000 · Cheese odeng (cheese fish cake), 1 person ₩10,000 · Ebi tenpura (shrimp tempura), 2 people ₩18,000 · Sujae odeng-tang (handmade fish cake soup)
places.hours_en: Sun–Thu 16:00–24:00 · Fri–Sat 16:00–02:00 · may close early when ingredients run out
places.off_en: Sources differ: open year-round, or closed 1st and 3rd Mondays (check before going)
places.summary_en: Daehangno bar serving handmade fish cakes, with the fish ground by hand in a stone mortar. Portions come for 1 or 2 people, so it suits solo drinking too.
places.tip_en: It opens at 4 PM and stays open until 2 AM on weekends, so go for an early dinner before a show or late after one; Naver booking is available but may need a Korean phone number.

places.name_en: Jin Okhwa Halmae Wonjo Dakhanmari, Main Branch (whole chicken stew)
places.menu_en: Dakhanmari (whole chicken stew) ₩33,000 · Tteok-sari (rice cake add-on) ₩2,000 · Guksu-sari (noodle add-on) ₩2,000 · Gamja-sari (potato add-on) ₩3,000
places.summary_en: A leading shop on Dongdaemun's dakhanmari street, open since 1978. A whole chicken is boiled in a clear, mild broth, and kalguksu noodles go in at the end.
places.tip_en: Weekend evening waits can reach 30–60 minutes, so weekday early evening or afternoon is better; if the main building is full, you can be directed to the annex.

places.menu_en: Kalguksu (knife-cut noodle soup) ₩12,000 · Mandu (dumplings) ₩13,000 · Bibim guksu (spicy mixed noodles) ₩12,000 · Kong-guksu (cold soy milk noodles, Apr–Oct) ₩13,000
places.hours_en: Daily 10:30–21:00 · last order 20:30 at the main branch, this branch not listed (check before going)
places.off_en: Lunar New Year's Day and Chuseok day
places.summary_en: Linked to the first Myeongdong Gyoja, founded in 1966, and serving kalguksu and dumplings at this spot since 1969. The rich chicken-broth kalguksu is the signature dish.
places.tip_en: No parking or valet, so use public transit; avoiding the lunch peak means shorter waits. You pay upfront, and packaged dumplings are sold to take away.
places.address_ko: 서울 중구 명동10길 8 (다이닝코드에는 명동10길 10, 지번 명동2가 33-4로 표기)

places.menu_en: Myeonghwadang gimbap (rice rolls) ₩4,800 · Tteokbokki (spicy rice cakes) ₩4,800 · Bibim jjolmyeon (spicy chewy noodles) ₩8,000 · Naembi guksu (noodles in a pot) ₩8,500
places.hours_en: Daily 09:00–22:30 (some sources say close 22:00, last order 21:30; check before going)
places.summary_en: Old-style snack shop on the second floor of a Myeongdong alley, running for over 40 years. Tangy gimbap, bibim jjolmyeon and pot noodles are the main dishes.
places.tip_en: Many customers get takeout. Reviews say jjolmyeon is hit or miss, so try it alongside the gimbap.

places.menu_en: Tteokbokki (spicy rice cakes) ₩5,000 · Mandu (dumplings) ₩3,000 · Sundae (Korean blood sausage) ₩5,000
places.off_en: 4th Sunday of each month (check before going)
places.summary_en: Small snack shop in an alley near Myeongdong Cathedral, known for rice-cake tteokbokki with strong garlic flavor and rich sauce.
places.tip_en: It's tiny inside and fits about seven or eight people; some years it closes for about a month in summer, so check Naver notices in July–August.

places.menu_en: Deulkkae kalguksu (perilla seed knife-cut noodle soup) ₩8,500 · Deulkkae sujebi (perilla seed hand-torn dough soup) ₩8,500 · Son sujebi (hand-torn dough soup) ₩7,000 · Janchi guksu (banquet noodles), small ₩5,000
places.hours_en: Daily 10:00–22:30 (some sources say opens 11:00; check before going)
places.off_en: Seems open year-round, but may close on holidays (check before going)
places.summary_en: Long-running noodle shop on the Sejong Village food street by Gyeongbokgung Station, serving thick perilla kalguksu, cheap janchi guksu, plus jeon and makgeolli snacks.
places.tip_en: A Tongin Market branch (Jahamun-ro 15-gil 11) and a pork-rib restaurant (Jahamun-ro 1-gil 24) share the name but are separate with different menus, so check the address; there is no parking lot.

places.menu_en: Beoseot gul gukbap (mushroom oyster rice soup) ₩11,000 · Beoseot gul sundubu (mushroom oyster soft tofu stew) ₩11,000 · Beoseot gul jeon (mushroom oyster pancake) ₩25,000 · Gul bossam (oyster wraps), large: price not confirmed (check before going)
places.hours_en: Open 24 hours (some sources list a break 15:00–16:00; check before going)
places.summary_en: 24-hour oyster restaurant long open in front of Sindang Station; oyster rice soup by day, oyster bossam and eel for drinks at night.
places.tip_en: Reviews say lunch (before 2 pm) is crowded with office workers and there's a wait, so after 2 pm is calmer; parking is tight, about 2 spots at the front and back door.

places.menu_en: Ttaengcho gopchang (spicy chili intestines) ₩15,000 · Yachae gopchang (intestines with vegetables) ₩14,000 · Sogeum gui (salt-grilled) ₩15,000 · Yangnyeom gui (marinated, grilled) ₩15,000 · Odolppyeo (crunchy pork cartilage) ₩14,000
places.off_en: Reviews say closed the 1st–4th Monday of each month (check before going)
places.summary_en: Gopchang restaurant between Sindang and Dongmyo-ap stations, popular for spicy ttaengcho gopchang, yachae gopchang and grilled dishes at fairly low prices.
places.tip_en: Reviews say an annex next door clears the wait quickly; for fried rice, leave some gopchang uneaten because they stir-fry it with the leftovers, and parking is hard.

places.menu_en: Cheonggukjang (fermented soybean stew) ₩9,000 · Saeng samgyeopsal (fresh pork belly) ₩16,000 · Sogeum gui (salt-grilled meat) ₩16,000 · Boribibimbap (barley bibimbap): price not confirmed (check before going)
places.summary_en: Cheonggukjang specialist in a Sindang-dong alley, with a stew in the ₩9,000 range plus barley bibimbap and grilled pork belly.
places.tip_en: Sindang Station public parking lot is nearby, so park there; parking at the restaurant differs by source (check before going).

places.menu_en: Sundae-guk (blood sausage soup) ₩10,000 · Special sundae-guk ₩12,000
places.hours_en: Mon–Fri 09:30–19:30 · Sat 09:30–19:00 · no break listed (check before going)
places.summary_en: Sundae-guk specialist near Sindang Station, often praised for clear, clean broth with Cheongyang chili and plenty of lean meat.
places.tip_en: Reviews say there's a steady wait of one or two groups around 1 pm, so go a bit off-peak; it may close early if ingredients run out, so check late in the day.

places.menu_en: Saeng deunggalbi (pork back ribs, salt-seasoned) ₩15,000 · Dwaeji kkori (pig tail) ₩13,000 · Kkomjangeo (grilled hagfish) ₩15,000–16,000 · Dwaeji galbi (pork ribs) ₩13,000–14,000
places.summary_en: Pub-style grill near Sindang Station. Named for hagfish, but better known for pre-grilled charcoal pork ribs and pig tail. Weekends have a queue.
places.tip_en: Weekends may have a queue; ribs are ordered from 2 portions, and staff ask for your order when your turn comes, so decide ahead.

places.name_en: Haokao Seutaen, Sindang Branch (hotpot & lamb skewers)
places.menu_en: Sutbul hoguo (tan huoguo, charcoal hotpot) set ₩54,000 · Yang kkochi (lamb skewers) ₩14,000 · So kkochi (beef skewers) ₩17,000 · Cilantro cream kkanpung shrimp (fried shrimp in sweet-spicy sauce) ₩28,000
places.summary_en: Lamb skewer restaurant where you turn wooden skewers over a charcoal brazier yourself. Upstairs, hotpot comes in a pot with a center charcoal column.
places.tip_en: Weekend evenings can have long waits (one review: about 2 hours, 18 groups ahead); skewers take time to grill, so go when you're not in a rush.

places.menu_en: Kalmandu (dumpling & knife-cut noodle soup) ₩12,000 · Bibim guksu (spicy mixed noodles) ₩13,000 · Jjinmandu (steamed dumplings) ₩12,000 · Mandu jeongol (dumpling hotpot, medium) ₩45,000
places.hours_en: Mon–Fri 11:30–21:00 (break 15:30–17:00, last order 14:40/20:10) · Sat 11:30–20:00 (check before going)
places.summary_en: Dumpling shop open since 1988 in a Bukchon alley near Anguk Station. Known for well-filled dumplings in kalmandu and jeongol, and bibim guksu topped with yukjeon (pan-fried beef).
places.tip_en: Waits are long, so join the remote queue on Catchtable or Tabling (may need a Korean phone number) and walk around Bukchon; no parking.

places.name_en: Miryang Sonmandu, Gyedong Main Branch (handmade dumplings)
places.menu_en: Eolkeun kaljebi (spicy knife-cut noodle & dough-flake soup) ₩12,000 · Gogi mandu (meat dumplings) ₩9,000 · Kimchi mandu (kimchi dumplings) ₩9,000 · Mandu jeongol (dumpling hotpot, medium) ₩37,000
places.hours_en: Mon–Fri 11:00–21:00 · Sat 11:00–20:00 · break 14:30 (or 14:40)–17:00 · last order 20:00 (check before going)
places.summary_en: Dumpling and noodle shop on Gyedong-gil near Anguk Station. Choose beef-bone or spicy broth; main dishes are kaljebi, mandu soup and jeongol.
places.tip_en: One review mentions waiting about 20 minutes at mealtimes and weekends, so try right after opening or just before the break.

places.menu_en: Sea urchin & eoran (salted dried fish roe) pasta ₩36,000 · Truffle cream gnocchi ₩27,000 · Hanu ragu pasta (Korean beef) ₩37,000 · Black truffle pasta ₩35,000
places.hours_en: Tue–Sat 12:00–22:00 · Sun 12:00–21:00 · break 15:00–18:00 (Sun until 17:30) (one source lists 12:00–15:00, 17:30–21:00; check before going)
places.off_en: Closed Mondays (an older source also lists 2nd and 4th Sundays; check before going)
places.summary_en: Small hanok Italian restaurant in an alley near Anguk Station and Bukchon. The sea urchin & eoran pasta and truffle cream gnocchi are mentioned often.
places.tip_en: The place is small with mostly bar seats, so reserve ahead on Catchtable (may need a Korean phone number); dinner last order is reportedly early, so go early.

places.menu_en: Grilled chicken 600g (2 people) ₩39,000 · Grilled chicken 800g (3 people) ₩52,000 · Assorted grilled chicken 1000g (4 people) ₩65,000 · Myeongran deopbap (pollock roe rice bowl) ₩9,000
places.hours_en: Tue–Sun 17:00–23:00 · last order 22:00 (some sources say opens 16:00; check before going)
places.summary_en: Japanese-style grilled chicken place in an alley near Euljiro 3-ga Station. Assorted chicken cuts are charcoal-grilled; many say the clean setting is good for talking.
places.tip_en: A review says seats open up after 8:30 pm on weekdays and reservations only work on weekdays before 6 pm; weekends are hard, and one drink per table is required.

places.menu_en: Sagol kalguksu (beef bone knife-cut noodle soup) ₩10,000 · Saengbaechu bossam (boiled pork with fresh cabbage, small) ₩23,000 · Pajeon (scallion pancake)
places.summary_en: A noodle and bossam shop near Cheonggyecheon, open for over 60 years, known for rich bone broth and tender boiled pork.
places.tip_en: Weekdays 12:00–13:00 are crowded, so go around 17:00 when the break ends; you can ask to share one bowl of noodles and they will bring an extra bowl.

places.menu_en: Bulkkochi baekban (charcoal-grilled pork set, for 2) ₩20,000 · Godeungeo gui (grilled mackerel) ₩12,000 · Jeyuk bokkeum (spicy stir-fried pork) ₩9,000 · Kimchi eomuk bokkeum (stir-fried kimchi and fish cake) ₩8,000
places.summary_en: An old set-meal restaurant at the start of Dongdaemun's grilled fish alley, serving pork and fish grilled over charcoal briquettes.
places.tip_en: A line can form after 12:00 on weekdays, so go right at opening or avoid the lunch peak; there is no parking.

places.name_en: Nanumi Tteokbokki, Sungkyunkwan Univ. Main Branch
places.menu_en: Ssal tteokbokki (rice cakes in spicy sauce) ₩5,000 · Chapssal sundae (glutinous rice sausage) ₩5,000 · Gimbap ₩5,000 · Busan eomuk (fish cake), 1 piece ₩1,500
places.summary_en: A snack shop in front of Sungkyunkwan University, open 24 hours for many years, with chewy rice cakes in sweet sauce and a short menu.
places.tip_en: There is no private parking, so use public transit or a nearby public car park; fish cake for takeout starts at 2 pieces.

places.menu_en: Kalguksu (knife-cut noodle soup) ₩11,000 · Yangji suyuk (boiled beef brisket, small) ₩30,000 · Suyuk with octopus (small) ₩30,000 · Seolleongtang (beef bone soup) (price: check before going)
places.hours_en: Mon–Fri 11:00–13:30 · may close early when sold out (sources differ on opening time, 11:00 or 11:30; check before going)
places.off_en: Closed Sat, Sun and public holidays (check before going)
places.summary_en: A handmade noodle shop with rich broth from beef brisket and bones, open only two weekday lunch hours; many order thick brisket or octopus on the side.
places.tip_en: It is open only 2 hours on weekdays and closes when ingredients run out, so arrive at opening time; it may close even earlier in winter.

places.menu_en: Galbi chaofan (beef rib fried rice) ₩9,800 · Sanseo-cho kkwobaro-u (crispy sweet-and-sour pork, large) ₩20,000 · Kkanpunggi (spicy fried chicken, large) ₩20,000 · Dandanmian (dan dan noodles)
places.summary_en: A Taiwanese- and Hong Kong-style fusion Chinese restaurant on an alley's 2nd floor near Hyehwa Station, known for fried rice, fried noodles and kkwobaro-u.
places.tip_en: Lines are common at lunch and dinner peaks and portions are big, so order one dish each and add only a few dishes to share; the break is 15:30–16:30.

places.menu_en: Guksi (noodle soup) ₩12,000 · Saengseon twigim (fried fish, small) ₩20,000 · Suyuk (boiled pork, small) ₩20,000
places.hours_en: Daily 11:00–21:00 · break 15:00–16:00 · last order 20:30 (check before going)
places.off_en: An older source says closed on holiday days and the day after (check before going)
places.summary_en: A bone broth noodle shop in Hyehwa-dong, open for decades; many pair the mild noodle soup with soft fried fish.
places.tip_en: There is parking for about 10 cars in front, and showing your receipt after the meal gives you 1 hour; avoid the 15:00–16:00 break.
